✏️ Unit 1 Questions
📖 Look! - Unit 1 Grammar (p. 67-68)
1 Present Simple
He usually checks his email in the morning.
He doesn't usually check his email in the morning.
Does he usually check his email in the morning?
Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
How often do you play volleyball?
I play volleyball once / twice / three times a week.
2 Present Continuous
I'm reading a book now.
He is having breakfast now.
They are doing karate at the moment.
I'm not reading a book now.
She isn't tidying her room now.
We aren't watching TV right now.
Are you reading a book? Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Is Hasna doing her homework? Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Are the children playing in the garden? Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
3 a / the / Possessives
There's a bike in the garden. The bike is red.
That is Mr Smith's spacesuit. It's his.
4 Going to - Future
I'm going to take part in the competition.
I'm not going to take part in the competition.
Are you going to take part in the competition?
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
5 Past Simple
Jane went for a walk yesterday.
Jane didn't go for a walk yesterday. She stayed at home.
Did Jane go for a walk yesterday? Yes, she did. / No, she didn't.
6 Past Continuous
Tim was sleeping yesterday at nine o'clock.
Lolwah wasn't surfing the Net yesterday at five o'clock.
Were Ron and Peter playing a computer game? Yes, they were. / No, they weren't.
7 When / While
I was reading a book when my brother arrived home.
While Hind was shopping, her mobile phone rang.

🖊️ Topic One — Favourite Hobby (EMAIL)
Source task: Below is an email Hamad has sent to Sami to tell him about his favourite hobby.

Write an EMAIL of seven sentences to tell your friend about your favourite hobby.
  • What is your favourite hobby?
  • How often do you practise it?
  • Where/When do you practise it?
📌 Completed source model:

Hi Sami,
How are you? I hope you are fine. I am writing to tell you about a hobby I like. My favourite hobby is football. I play for Al-Sadd club. I play football every day. My friends always play with me. Write back soon!

Yours,
Hamad
✨ Polished model answer — 7 sentences:

Hi Sami,
How are you? I hope you are fine. I am writing to tell you about my favourite hobby. My favourite hobby is playing football. I practise it every day after school with my friends. We usually play at Al-Sadd club in the afternoon. I love this hobby because it is fun and keeps me healthy.

Best wishes,
Hamad

Model Answer:

Hi Sami,
How are you? I hope you are fine. I am writing to tell you about my favourite hobby. My favourite hobby is playing football. I practise it every day after school with my friends. We usually play at Al-Sadd club in the afternoon. I love this hobby because it is fun and keeps me healthy.

Best wishes,
Hamad
🖊️ Topic Two — An Unlucky Day (STORY)
Source task: Below is a story Khaled has written about an unlucky day.

Write a STORY of seven sentences to tell your friend about an unlucky day.
  • Where did you go?
  • Who went with you?
  • What happened?
📌 Completed source model:

Last weekend, Ali and I went to the park. We rode our bikes to the park. We enjoyed our lunch there. Suddenly, it started raining. We decided to go back home. We were riding our bikes when Ali’s bike slipped. He fell off and hurt his leg. We didn’t know what to do. While we were waiting, my uncle came. He took us back home.
✨ Polished model answer — 7 sentences:

Last weekend, Ali and I went to the park. We rode our bikes there and enjoyed our lunch. Suddenly, it started raining, so we decided to go back home. While we were riding, Ali’s bike slipped. He fell off and hurt his leg. We waited for help, and my uncle came and took us home. It was an unlucky day, but we were safe in the end.
